sections.title: Entertainment Revenue Prediction ML
sections.description: For Disney, Universal, Warner Bros., Netflix LA, and the major studios.

blocks.heading: Box office revenue prediction
paragraphs: ML predicting theatrical box office performance from pre-release signals — trailer view counts, social media sentiment, opening weekend competition, and the genre and talent factors that correlate with box office success. Studios use box office prediction for marketing budget allocation, release date decisions, and licensing negotiations.

blocks.heading: Streaming viewership prediction
paragraphs: ML predicting streaming platform viewership for Netflix's and Disney+'s content decisions — which titles will drive subscriber acquisition, which will drive retention, and which require marketing investment vs. organic audience development.

blocks.heading: Talent and IP valuation ML
paragraphs: ML for valuing entertainment IP — predicting future revenue streams from franchise extensions, licensing deals, and distribution windows for entertainment asset acquisition and development budget decisions.

sections.title: Healthcare Clinical and Managed Care ML
sections.description: For Cedars-Sinai, UCLA Health, Kaiser Permanente SoCal, and LA's health systems.

blocks.heading: Clinical risk stratification
paragraphs: ML for Cedars-Sinai's and Kaiser's enormous California patient populations — readmission prediction, clinical deterioration, and chronic disease management prioritization.

blocks.heading: Medi-Cal population health
paragraphs: ML for the managed care organizations serving LA County's massive Medi-Cal population — the largest county Medicaid market in the US creates population health ML applications at a scale that most US health systems don't approach.

blocks.heading: Healthcare AI equity
paragraphs: LA's health equity AI requirement — California AB 2520's health equity mandate — requires healthcare ML to explicitly assess demographic disparities in model performance. ClickMasters designs LA healthcare ML with health equity evaluation as standard.

sections.title: Financial Services ML
sections.description: For City National Bank (Beverly Hills), East West Bank (Pasadena), and LA's financial services community.

blocks.heading: Entertainment lending credit ML
paragraphs: ML for City National's entertainment production loan portfolio — predicting production completion risk, studio distribution guarantee quality, and borrower financial stress for the specialized credit risk of film and television production financing.

blocks.heading: Commercial real estate credit
paragraphs: ML for LA's commercial real estate lending community — predicting CRE loan performance incorporating LA's specific real estate dynamics (rent control, wildfire risk, coastal flooding).

blocks.heading: Alternative credit for LA's diverse consumer market
paragraphs: ML for consumer lending serving LA's diverse consumer community — FCRA-compliant alternative credit scoring with ECOA disparate impact testing for California's large Spanish-speaking and Asian American consumer communities.

sections.title: Wildfire Risk and Climate ML
sections.description: For LA's insurance, real estate, and government organizations.

blocks.heading: Wildfire risk ML
paragraphs: Property-level wildfire risk prediction incorporating CalFire Hazard Severity Zone, vegetation data, slope, aspect, and historical fire perimeter data — directly applicable to California's post-wildfire insurance underwriting crisis.

blocks.heading: Post-disaster property valuation
paragraphs: ML for property value estimation following wildfire events — incorporating distance to burn perimeter, reconstruction cost, and the insurance settlement dynamics that affect post-disaster market values.

sections.title: Los Angeles ML regulatory context
sections.description: Key regulatory considerations for ML development in Los Angeles.

blocks.heading: CCPA for all consumer ML
paragraphs: Every ML application using California consumer data must comply with CCPA — data minimization, purpose limitation, and consumer rights. ClickMasters designs all LA ML with CCPA as baseline.

blocks.heading: California health equity (AB 2520)
paragraphs: Healthcare ML in California must assess demographic equity in model performance — ClickMasters delivers health equity evaluation as a standard deliverable for LA healthcare ML.

blocks.heading: California insurance (Prop 103)
paragraphs: Insurance ML pricing in California requires California DOI approval — ClickMasters designs California insurance ML within Prop 103 rate filing constraints.
